# Minimum mutation score, as a whole-number percentage of caught / (caught + missed).
#
# Enforced in two places, both against this one number:
#   - Mutants (weekly)  — the whole crate on `main`. This is the real signal.
#   - Mutants (PR diff) — only when the diff has enough mutants to mean anything.
#
# Raise it when the weekly run has cleared the new value twice in a row. Never
# lower it to make a red build green — a drop is the signal, not the problem.
#
# Seeded deliberately low. Measured locally at 63% (822 caught / 1285 scored)
# over 1407 of 2192 mutants — 64% of the crate, in two partial runs. The
# untested remainder is almost all `src/cli/subcmd/*`, which scored worse than
# the rest, so the true figure is likely a few points under 63%. 50% is the
# floor that number clears with room to spare; the first full weekly run
# replaces the estimate with a measurement.
50
